Lighting and visibility presets

Project author: ly. Q2PRO-X 1.6 Beta 5.

The main menu and in-game menu provide a common Presets entry. It brings together ordinary AVFX, lighting, visibility and separate AVFX player-contact presets.

The common entry point for all preset categories.

Categories

CategoryApplies
AVFXWeather, skies, surfaces and other AVFX effects
LightingBrightness, saturation, lighting model and dynamic light
VisibilityPlayer, model-part, weapon and item highlighting; ordinary Bloom
AVFX Player Contact EffectsBlood, spray, impact marks and related effects

A preset applies to the current game. Each variable keeps its existing save scope: global values stay global, and mod values remain in the corresponding mod configuration. Some values can therefore change when switching mods. Both new menus link to related settings and Mod Configs at the bottom.

Lighting

There are 38 parameters. Gameplay presets include Default (Q2PRO-X), Bright, Monochrome, Saturated, Nothing Extra and Luxurious Darkness. The AVFX category contains Default (Q2PRO-X), Alternative, Simplified, Warm Saturated and Calm Cool. The two Default entries belong to different categories and are different snapshots.

For AVFX describes the purpose of the lighting, not enabling weather or materials. Choose effects through an ordinary AVFX preset. Video is restarted only when a changed parameter requires it; reapplying existing values does not restart it unnecessarily.

gl_polyblend, which controls screen flashes for damage, pickups and being underwater, is not lighting and is excluded from lighting presets. Factory presets omit it and user slots do not save it. Older user presets still load, but any gl_polyblend line is ignored, preserving the player's screen-flash choice.

Gameplay lighting, AVFX lighting and separate user presets. Russian reference screenshot; the table below describes the English controls.

Visibility

The set contains 123 highlighting and ordinary-Bloom parameters. Skins, model replacements, player name and download settings are excluded. Male/female/cyborg colour and highlighting apply to the corresponding model regardless of its skin.

Factory choices include:

Default (all highlights off);
Player Model Parts, Items and Light Bloom;
Red Males, Green Females and Blue Cyborgs;
FFA (automatic model colours);
Purple Males, Lime Females, added in Beta 4 from an author's user slot, including

visibility, Bloom and individual model colours.

The first option disables highlighting masters and ordinary Bloom. It does not change AVFX Bloom categories; the same exclusion applies to all factory and user visibility presets and the generator. Independent model colouring works with EGL/ANGLE and WGL. Saving personal presets is unchanged.

Factory and user visibility presets and the generation button. Russian reference screenshot.

Four user slots per category

There are eight slots: four lighting and four visibility slots, shared by all mods. Save captures the current values of the selected category, Load applies them, and Rename changes the displayed name. Dialogues work like AVFX user presets.

A shared slot does not make its constituent variables global: subsequent configuration saving and mod switching still follow their ordinary rules.

Visibility generator

One button generates and immediately applies a random set. Highlighting masters are enabled, and the remaining parameters vary within supported ranges. This is neither the AVFX generator nor a lighting generator. Save a result you like in a visibility slot. Generating again changes the current appearance but does not automatically overwrite a saved slot.
